about_me.heading: About me
about_me.text: Since a very young age I loved messing around with computers and hardware in general. When I was about 6 I learnt to code in Java for purpose of writing Minecraft server plugins and mods. Since then I learnt many other languages such as C, PHP, Javascript, Typescript and others, although I suck at graphical design, I try my best. Since I begun using the Wired, I switched handles and nicknames many times but I hope my current identity will stay with me for a long time. I have done tons of small side projects, in all of which I've lost interest. This site however I hope will keep me entertained for a very long time.

xmpp.title: Jabber Server
xmpp.about_text1: The lain.rocks XMPP/Jabber server is a free as in freedom, private place for communication open to everyone at lain.rocks.
xmpp.about_text2: You can create an account using any XMPP client that supports account registration, for example
xmpp.about_text5: The registration link can be found above.
xmpp.about_text6: For better privacy, we recommend connecting to the server over Tor. The onion address is:
xmpp.about_text7: Make sure your XMPP client is configured to use Tor as a proxy.
xmpp.about_text8: Our server also offers a Biboumi IRC gateway, allowing you to connect to IRC channels via XMPP.
xmpp.about_text9: Additionally, a Telegram gateway will be available soon, enabling communication with Telegram users through XMPP.
xmpp.about_text10: If you need help setting up your XMPP client or have any questions, feel free to reach out in the support MUC room
xmpp.about_text11: or contact us via email at
xmpp.about_text12: For crucial information regarding the XMPP service, please refer to the announcements on the homepage,
xmpp.about_text13: and read the Terms of Service available
xmpp.about_text17: Enjoy your stay on the lain.rocks XMPP server!
xmpp.security_text: Remember to never trust your provider with your privacy. Always use end-to-end encryption like OMEMO or PGP to keep your communications safe and private.
xmpp.warning_text1: She wants to read your correspondence, but I won't let her!
